**Coaching note (80 words):**

You missed a royal fork! When your knight moves to c7, it gives check to the king on e8 *and* attacks the undefended rook on a8. The king must move out of check, and then your knight captures the rook on the next move—a clean win of the exchange (rook for knight). Spot this pattern: after your opponent moves a piece, check for knight moves that attack both the king and a loose piece. These tactical blows end games quickly.
